description: Figure 1 is a horizontal bar chart illustrating the number of tasks by language family. The vertical axis contains the categorical variables representing different language families, ordered from top to bottom. The horizontal axis is the value axis, labeled "# tasks," which uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80 with numeric tick marks and corresponding vertical grid lines at intervals of 10. The chart displays ten horizontal bars, sorted in descending order based on their length. Each bar is rendered in a distinct color and features a thin black outline. The longest bar at the top represents "IE-Slavic" in light blue with a value of approximately 79. This is followed by "IE-Romance" in dark blue at roughly 47, "IE-Germanic" in light green at approximately 44, "Uralic" in dark green at exactly 20, "IE-Baltic" in pink at about 17, "IE-other" in red at 15, "IE-Indic" in light orange at exactly 10, "Semitic" in dark orange at approximately 8, and "Turkic" in light purple at roughly 4. The shortest bar at the bottom represents "Basque" in dark purple, indicating approximately 3 tasks.
